/* PcccMapper.selectsendDataList : Pccc 알림톡 전송 데이터 */ SELECT cusId.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO AS CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO , cusId.ENT_CODE AS ENT_CODE , cusId.HBL_NO AS HBL_NO , cusId.INPUT_METHOD AS INPUT_METHOD , cusId.PO_NO AS PO_NO , cusId.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS CUST_CODE_LV1 , cusId.COMMODITY_ITEM AS COMMODITY_ITEM , cusId.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CUSTOMS_ID, '') = '' THEN ISNULL(cusId.ORIG_CUSTOMS_ID, '') ELSE ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CUSTOMS_ID, '') END AS CUSTOMS_ID , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_NAME, '') = '' THEN ISNULL(cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_NAME, '') ELSE ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_NAME, '') END AS CONSIGNEE_NAME , ISNULL(cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_HP, '') AS CONSIGNEE_HP , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE, '') = '' THEN ISNULL(cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE, '') ELSE ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE, '') END AS CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_F_NAME, '') = '' THEN ISNULL(cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_F_NAME, '') ELSE ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_F_NAME, '') END AS CONSIGNEE_F_NAME , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_L_NAME, '') = '' THEN ISNULL(cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_L_NAME, '') ELSE ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_L_NAME, '') END AS CONSIGNEE_L_NAME , rst.ERROR_CODE FROM TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO cusId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO , r.SEQ_NO_ID , r.ERROR_CODE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO ORDER BY r.SEQ_NO_ID DESC) AS RN FROM TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO_RESULT r ) rst ON rst.TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO = cusId.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO AND rst.RN = 1 WHERE 1=1 AND
(cusId.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO = #{item.customsIdJobNo} AND cusId.ENT_CODE = #{item.entCode})

/* SmsRecvMapper.selectKakaoInfo : 카카오톡 전송정보 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 mng.TEMPLATE_CODE ,mng.RESEND_MSG_TYPE ,mng.LABEL_NAME ,mng.MSG_TYPE ,mng.RESEND_MSG_TYPE ,tmp.SUBJECT ,tmp.TEMPLATE ,tmp.RESEND_TEMPLATE ,tmp.BUTTON1_URL ,tmp.BUTTON1_NAME ,tmp.BUTTON1_TYPE ,tmp.BUTTON2_URL ,tmp.BUTTON2_NAME ,tmp.BUTTON2_TYPE ,tmp.BUTTON3_URL ,tmp.BUTTON3_NAME ,tmp.BUTTON3_TYPE ,tmp.BUTTON4_URL ,tmp.BUTTON4_NAME ,tmp.BUTTON4_TYPE ,tmp.BUTTON5_URL ,tmp.BUTTON5_NAME ,tmp.BUTTON5_TYPE FROM TB_MMS_MANAGEMENT mng INNER JOIN exps_master.dbo.TB_MMS_TEMPLATE tmp ON tmp.TEMPLATE_TYPE = mng.TEMPLATE_TYPE AND tmp.TEMPLATE_SEQ_NO = mng.TEMPLATE_SEQ_NO WHERE mng.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND mng.TEMPLATE_TYPE = #{srchTemplateType}
AND mng.TEMPLATE_CODE = #{srchTemplateCode}

/* common.selectKakaoInfoEnterprise : 카카오톡 전송정보 조회 */ SELECT ent.SMS_USER_ID ,ent.SMS_CID_NUM ,ent.SMS_SEND_TEL_NO ,ent.ENT_CODE ,ent.ENT_NAME ,ent.ENT_MAPPING_CODE FROM exps_master.dbo.TB_SMS_ENTERPRISE ent WHERE ent.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode}

/* pcccMapper.selectSendSmsCustomsIdVerify : 전자상거래 SMS전송데이터조회 - 개인통관정보 요청 안내 */ SELECT cusId.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO ,cusId.HBL_NO ,cusId.PO_NO ,cusId.ORIG_CUSTOMS_ID ,cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_NAME ,cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_HP ,cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_F_NAME ,cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_L_NAME ,(SELECT ENT_NAME FROM exps_master.dbo.TB_SMS_ENTERPRISE WHERE ENT_CODE = cusId.ENT_CODE) AS ENT_NAME ,( SELECT TOP 1 cus.TEL FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS bus INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus ON cus.ENT_CODE = bus.ENT_CODE AND cus.CUSTOMER_CODE = bus.CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE bus.ENT_CODE = cusId.ENT_CODE ) AS TEL , ent.SMS_SEND_TEL_NO FROM TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO cusId LEFT JOIN exps_master.dbo.TB_SMS_ENTERPRISE ent ON ent.ENT_CODE = cusId.ENT_CODE WHERE cusId.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO = #{CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO}

/* /* PcccMapper.selectOrderPodStatusList */ : 오더 pod조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,pod.POD_STATUS ,CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE,'1900-01-01'),' ',ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME,'00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT NAME_KOR FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = pod.POD_STATUS) AS POD_STATUS_NAME ,pod.COURIER_NAME ,pod.REGISTER_USER_ID ,usr.USER_LOGIN_ID ,usr.USER_NAME AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,od.HBL_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,ISNULL(od.PIECES,0) AS PIECES ,ISNULL(od.PIECES_REAL,0) AS PIECES_REAL ,ISNULL(od.GWT,0) AS GWT ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(od.MRN, '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN NULLIF(od.MSN, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(od.HSN, '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(od.MRN, '-', od.MSN, '-', od.HSN) WHEN NULLIF(od.MSN, '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(od.MRN, '-', od.MSN) ELSE od.MRN END END AS SHIPMENT_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN ( SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME, COURIER_NAME, REGISTER_USER_ID FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM340','ECM410','ECM360','ECM390','ECM361','ECM420','ECM400') ) pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_USER usr ON usr.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND usr.USER_ID = pod.REGISTER_USER_ID WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ORDER BY
POD_DATE_TIME DESC

SELECT ENT_CODE , DELIVERY_CODE , RECV_API_URL , RECV_API_CODE , RECV_API_ID , RECV_API_PW , TRACKING_API_URL FROM TB_SMS_DELIVERY_API_INFO WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND DELIVERY_CODE = #{deliveryCode}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt, STUFF(( SELECT ','+ POD_STATUS FROM ${podTableName} WHERE pod.OD_JOB_NO = OD_JOB_NO
AND POD_STATUS IN (#{item} )
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS podStatus FROM ${podTableName} pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odjobno}
AND pod.POD_STATUS IN (#{item} )
AND pod.POD_STATUS IN (#{item} )
GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO

/** PcccMapper.selectDeliveryApiInfoKd */ SELECT KD_ADDR1 ,KD_ADDR2 ,KD_NAME ,KD_TEL1 ,KD_TEL2 ,KD_ZIPCODE ,KD_CUST_SEND_NO ,KD_AUTH_KEY ,TRACKING_KD_YN ,KOREX_ID ,KOREX_CUST_ID ,KOREX_METHOD ,KOREX_TOKEN_NUM ,KOREX_TOKEN_EXPRTN_DTM ,TRACKING_KOREX_YN FROM TB_SMS_DELIVERY_COMP_INFO WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND EMS_ID = 'COMMON'

/** pcccMapper.selectOrderMultiList */ SELECT od.HBL_NO as hblNo ,od.PO_NO as poNo ,od.OD_JOB_NO as odjobno ,od.DELIVERY_CODE as deliveryCode ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 ,od.DEST_PORT ,od.BOUND ,teom.DELIVERY_NO as deliveryNo ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(teom.OD_JOB_NO,'') != '' THEN 'multi' ELSE 'N' END multi_chk ,teom.SEQ_NO_ID as chkSeq ,teom.DELIVERY_CODE as multiChangeDeliveryCode ,teom.RETURN_DELIVERY_NO as returnDeliveryNo ,teom.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED as deliveryNoChanged ,teom.SEQ_NO_ID as seqNoId FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI teom ON od.OD_JOB_NO = teom.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/** pcccMapper.selectDeliveryApiInfoAllMapping */ SELECT TOP 1 KD_ADDR1 ,KD_ADDR2 ,KD_NAME ,KD_TEL1 ,KD_TEL2 ,KD_ZIPCODE ,KD_CUST_SEND_NO ,KD_AUTH_KEY ,TRACKING_KD_YN ,KOREX_ID ,KOREX_CUST_ID ,KOREX_METHOD ,KOREX_TOKEN_NUM ,KOREX_TOKEN_EXPRTN_DTM ,TRACKING_KOREX_YN ,SENDER_TELNO1 ,SENDER_TELNO2 ,SENDER_TELNO3 ,SENDER_ADDR ,SENDER_ADDR_DTL ,SENDER_ZIPCODE ,SENDER_INFO_USEYN FROM TB_SMS_DELIVERY_COMP_INFO WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = #{srchCustomerCode} AND BOUND = #{srchBound}
AND LOGISTICS_CODE = #{srchLogisticsCode}
/* pcccMapper.selectOdInfo */ SELECT MAX(HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI mul ON od.OD_JOB_NO = mul.OD_JOB_NO WHERE mul.DELIVERY_NO = #{srchNo}

SELECT CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE,'1900-01-01'),' ',ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME,'00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT NAME_KOR FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = pod.POD_STATUS) AS POD_STATUS_NAME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,pod.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND BL_NO = #{deliveryNo}

/* PcccMapper.selectSendCustomsInfo : 쿠팡PCCC전송정보 */ SELECT cusId.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO AS CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO , cusId.ENT_CODE AS ENT_CODE , cusId.REQUEST_ID AS REQUEST_ID , cusId.INPUT_METHOD AS INPUT_METHOD , cusId.HBL_NO AS HBL_NO , cusId.PO_NO AS PO_NO , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT(DATE, cusId.PO_DATE_TIME), 120) AS PO_DATE_TIME , cusId.PCCC_DATE_TIME AS PCCC_DATE_TIME , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CUSTOMS_ID, '') = '' THEN cusId.AFTER_CUSTOMS_ID ELSE cusId.ORIG_CUSTOMS_ID END AS CUSTOMS_ID , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_NAME, '') = '' THEN cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_NAME ELSE cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_NAME END AS CONSIGNEE_NAME , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_F_NAME, '') = '' THEN cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_F_NAME ELSE cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_F_NAME END AS CONSIGNEE_F_NAME , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_L_NAME, '') = '' THEN cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_L_NAME ELSE cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_L_NAME END AS CONSIGNEE_L_NAME , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_HP, '') = '' THEN cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_HP ELSE cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_HP END AS CONSIGNEE_HP , CASE WHEN ISNULL(cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE, '') = '' THEN cusId.ORIG_CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ELSE cusId.AFTER_CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE END AS CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE , CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), cusId.COUPANG_SEND_DATE_TIME, 120) AS COUPANG_SEND_DATE_TIME , cusId.REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS REGISTER_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO cusId WHERE 1=1 AND cusId.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND cusId.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND cusId.COUPANG_SEND_YN != 'Y' AND cusId.COUPANG_SEND_DATE_TIME IS NULL
mapper.update: /** OdMapper.updateSendCustomsInfo : 개인통관부호 검증 전송여부 처리 **/ UPDATE TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO SET COUPANG_SEND_YN = 'Y' ,COUPANG_SEND_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() ,UPDATE_USER_ID = 'DAEMON' ,UPDATE_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
mapper.select: /* pcccMapper.selectMultiNoList */ SELECT mul.DELIVERY_NO AS CODE , mul.DELIVERY_NO AS CODE_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI mul ON od.OD_JOB_NO = mul.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI mul ON od.OD_JOB_NO = mul.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.HBL_NO = #{srchNo} OR od.PO_NO = #{srchNo} OR mul.DELIVERY_NO = #{srchNo} )
